/dashboard/webhooks lists delivery attempts: Request, URL, Status, At.
Usage page: usage over time, top endpoints by spend, per-endpoint quantity/unit type/discount/net rate/cost.

Entities are the referents of the '@ to reference entities' affordance in playground prompts.
